in_marathi.name: Amrit
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Nectar of immortality
in_marathi.long_meaning: Amrit हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। In Hindu mythology, the nectar of immortality, Amrita, is a divine drink that grants eternal life. In the epic Mahabharata, the gods and demons churned the ocean to obtain Amrit, leading to the creation of various celestial beings.
